==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|extensioun}}, from {{der|en|fro|estension}}, from {{der|en|la|extensiō|extensiō, extensiōnem}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪkˈstɛnʃən/|/ɛkˈstɛnʃən/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-extension.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|ex|ten|sion}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The act of [[extend]]ing; a [[stretch]]ing out; [[enlargement]] in length, breadth, or [[time]]; an [[increase]].
#: {{ux|en|Next month the house is undergoing an '''extension'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Due to the unforeseen circumstances, you are allowed an '''extension''' of two weeks to complete the task.}}
# The state of being extended.
#* {{RQ:Browne Pseudodoxia Epidemica|edition=2nd|passage=For station is properly no rest, but one kind of motion, relating unto that which physicians (from Galen) do name extensive or tonical; that is, an '''extension''' of the muscles and organs of motion, maintaining the body at length, or in its proper figure.}}
# {{senseid|en|space occupation}}That property of a [[body]] by which it occupies a portion of space (or time, e.g. "[[spatiotemporal]] extension").
# {{lb|en|mathematics|group theory|of a [[group]] <math>G</math> by a group <math>H</math>}} A [[short exact sequence]] <math>1\to H\to E\to G\to 1</math>, or the group <math>E</math> therein.
# {{lb|en|mathematics|[[homological algebra]]|of an [[object]] <math>A</math> by an object <math>B</math> in an [[abelian category]]}} A [[short exact sequence]] <math>0\to B\to E\to A\to 0</math>, or the object <math>E</math> therein.
# A part of a [[building]] that has been added onto the original.
# An [[outgrowth]]; a part of something that extends its capabilities.
#: {{ux|en|Parents who treat their children as an '''extension''' of themselves}}
#: {{ux|en|My research is an '''extension''' of the work of my mentor.}}
# {{senseid|en|semantics}} {{lb|en|semantics}} Capacity of a concept or general term to include a greater or smaller number of objects; — correlative of [[intension]].
#* {{quote-web|en|date=14 March 2023|author=Caryn James|title=John Wick: Chapter 4: 'Soars above most action films'|work=BBC|url=https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20230313-john-wick-chapter-4-soars-above-most-action-films|passage=Perversely, we love {{w|John Wick}} himself. That lethal, bereaved assassin is a good bad guy for our times, the natural '''extension''' of {{w|Tony Soprano}}, {{w|Walter White}} and all the other heroic antiheroes the culture has embraced. |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260824135656/https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20230313-john-wick-chapter-4-soars-above-most-action-films|archivedate=24 August 2026}}
#* {{quote-web
|en
|date=2011-07-20
|author=Edwin Mares
|title=Propositional Functions
|site=The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
|url=http://plato.stanford.edu/archives/fall2011/entries/propositional-function
|accessdate=2012-07-15
|passage=In addition to concepts and conceptual senses, Frege holds that there are [[extension]]s of concepts. Frege calls an [[extension]] of a concept a ‘course of values’. A course of values is determined by the value that the concept has for each of its arguments. Thus, the course of values for the concept ''__ is a dog'' records that its value for the argument Zermela is the True and for Socrates is the False, and so on. If two concepts have the same values for every argument, then their courses of values are the same. Thus, courses of values are extensional.}}
# {{lb|en|linguistics|semantics}} [[semantic|Semantic]] [[widening]], [[broadening]] of [[meaning]].
# {{lb|en|banking|finance}} A written [[engagement]] on the part of a creditor, allowing a debtor further time to pay a debt.
# {{lb|en|medicine}} The [[operation]] of stretching a broken bone so as to bring the fragments into the same straight line.
# {{lb|en|weightlifting}} An [[exercise]] in which an arm or leg is straightened against resistance.
# {{lb|en|fencing}} A simple offensive [[action]], consisting of extending the weapon arm forward.
# {{lb|en|telecommunication}} A numerical [[code]] used to indicate a specific telephone in a telecommunication network.
# {{senseid|en|filename extension}} {{lb|en|computing}} {{ellipsis of|en|file extension}}.
#: {{ux|en|Files with the ''.txt'' '''extension''' usually contain text.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1989|journal=PC Mag|volume=8|number=5|page=276
|passage=If you plan to plot data with error bars, you must name them with an. ERR '''extension'''. Failure to do so will crash the system, and you will lose your precious work.}}
# {{senseid|en|optional software component}} {{lb|en|computing}} An [[optional]] [[software]] [[component]] that adds [[functionality]] to an [[application]].
#: {{nsyn|en|plugin}}
#: {{ux|en|a browser '''extension'''}}
# {{lb|en|logic}} The set of [[tuple]]s of [[value]]s that, used as [[argument]]s, [[satisfy]] the [[predicate]].
# {{lb|en|grammar}} A kind of [[derivative]] [[morpheme]] applied to [[verb]]s in [[Bantu]] [[language]]s.
# {{c|en|Algebra}} {{lb|en|ring theory|of an [[ideal]] in the [[domain]] of a [[ring]] [[homomorphism]]}} The ideal in the [[codomain]] generated by the [[image]] of the given ideal under the given homomorphism.
# {{lb|en|education}} University programs that are targeted at the broader (usually adults) community whose participants are not full-time enrolled students.
# {{senseid|en|cosmetics}} {{lb|en|cosmetics|chiefly|in plural}} {{clip of|en|hair extension,nail extension,[[eyelash extensions|eyelash extension]]}}.
# {{lb|en|electronics|Philippines}} {{ellipsis of|en|extension cord}}.
